title:
What is person centred care?? 

Person centred care is about ensuring the tenants who use our service are at the centre of everything we do. 

Person centred care is delivered when professionals work together with people, to tailor services to support what matters to them. 

It ensures that care is personalised, co-ordinated and enabling so that tenants can make choices,  and live as independent as possible!
